jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game character animation sprite sheet.
Create ONE new plush animal identity inspired ONLY by the tactile rendering, potted composition and quality of the two reference images; do NOT copy their species.
Output landscape 1536x1024, an exact THREE-COLUMN TWO-ROW regular grid of equal 512x512 cells. Exactly FIVE complete sprites of the SAME animal. Top row left to right: IDLE (eyes open, relaxed small smile), ATTACK (small unmistakable open O mouth blowing upward, no bubble or projectile), SPENT (tired droopy half-closed eyes and slack mouth). Bottom row left to right: READY (puffed cheeks, pursed closed mouth), BLINK (both eyes completely closed and small relaxed smile), EMPTY transparent cell. For beaked animals, open the beak for attack.
Every sprite has the SAME front-facing slightly three-quarter pose, camera, head size, pot size, colors and soft upper-left light. ONLY facial expressions change. Animal is a large fuzzy head with small upper body emerging from two soft green leaves in a short polished felt flowerpot. No standing legs or full body. Maintain same pot bottom alignment in every cell at 86% of cell height; at least 12% clear transparent margin on all four cell edges including ears and horns. Each animal fits entirely in its cell. No clipping or cell overlap.
Materials: densely packed fine soft fur with visible fibers and fluffy edges, premium stuffed toy, glossy brown-black toy pupils in expressive eyes. Pot is tidy dense felt with continuous perfectly clean rolled rim, shallow refined decorative appliques; NO exposed seam line on pot rim, no stitching, no loose thread, no frayed fibers on pot edges. Soft dimensional lighting but no heavy dark shading. Preserve bright readable palette and an easily identifiable animal silhouette at 80px.
True transparent alpha background. No labels, numbers, text, grid lines, shadows on background, scenery, UI, balls, weapons or other objects.
Subject: light sky blue #42A9FF koala, enormous fluffy round tufted ears with cream inner ears, large tall charcoal oval nose, cream chin, no bear muzzle; sky-blue felt pot with pale cloud appliques.
jobs.repairPrompt: Edit this sprite sheet to correct sprite spacing ONLY. Preserve this exact blue koala, all five expressions, colors, fluffy texture, refined felt pots, clean rims and true transparency. Keep exact 1536x1024 canvas and 3 columns by 2 rows. Scale EACH complete toy down to 72% of its current width and height so each one has WIDE transparent padding and NEVER touches or crosses its 512x512 cell. Toy centers at x=256,768,1280 in first row and x=256,768 in second row. Pot bottom y=440 for top row and y=952 for bottom row. Exactly FIVE complete toys: idle / open O mouth attack / tired on top; puffed cheeks / eyes closed at bottom. Entire bottom-right cell empty transparent. No backdrop, shadows or glows. Do not crop any ear or fur. Fill margins with true alpha zero.
